# sharepoint_site_group (Resource)

Creates a SharePoint Online site group and assigns a permission level using the M365 CLI (m365 spo group add). The description can be updated in-place; all other attributes force replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sharepoint_site_group" "hr_editors" {
  site_url         = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr"
  name             = "HR Editors"
  description      = "Members can edit HR content but not delete it."
  permission_level = sharepoint_permission_level.contribute_no_delete.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the SharePoint site group.
- `site_url` (String) Full URL of the SharePoint site, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hub.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the site group. Can be updated in-place.
- `permission_level` (String) Name of the permission level (role definition) to assign to this group, e.g. Contribute, Read, or a custom level name. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `group_id` (Number) Numeric SharePoint ID of the site group.
- `id` (String) Composite resource ID: <site_url>|<group_id>.
